channel.title: South Coast Business Awards 2018 - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from South Coast Business Awards 2018 (dailyecho.co.uk)

item.title: More than 30 objections after plans submitted to turn house into 10-bed HMO
item.description: More than 30 residents are objecting to plans to convert a house into a 10-bedroom house in multiple occupation in Gosport.

item.title: World War II air raid warden marks milestone birthday as stylish centenarian
item.description: A stylish, elegant and determined lady who volunteered as an air raid warden during World War II is celebrating her 100th birthday this week.

item.title: Nearly 30 new homes to be built in controversial development
item.description: Controversial plans to build nearly thirty new homes in Fareham have been given the greenlight to go ahead.

item.title: The New Forest pub you can walk for miles from without crossing a road
item.description: The New Forest Inn at Emery Down is the historic New Forest pub where you can walk for miles without ever having to cross a road.

item.title: Drivers warned as Totton Bypass hit by council road works next month
item.description: Motorists are being warned of a closure of the Totton Bypass in March to allow for essential highway repairs.

item.title: Residents described Titchfield flooding as the worst in more than 25 years
item.description: Residents in Titchfield have described this winter’s flooding as the worst they have seen in more than 25 years, with cars stranded, roads closed and emergency services called to rescue motorists.

item.title: One of UK's biggest ships set to arrive in Southampton this month
item.description: One of the UK's biggest cruise ships will be in Southampton in March as ten cruise calls line up at the city’s port.

item.title: Police Federation warns of ‘exhausted’ officers due to Southampton protests
item.description: Officers across Hampshire are facing extended shifts and cancelled rest days ahead of another weekend protest, according to the head of the local federation.

item.title: Man walks free from court after fatally reversing into colleague at car wash
item.description: A car wash worker who killed a colleague by running him over has been sentenced after being found guilty at trial

item.title: Council says demolished 300-year-old cottage must be rebuilt
item.description: A Hampshire council has said a 300-year-old cottage in Nursling must be rebuilt after it was knocked down
